snippet.title: Rainbow Legends - Announcement Trailer | Territory-Control Roguelike Deck Builder
snippet.description:
In this tactical roguelike deck-builder, claim and defend territories as you battle across a dynamic map. Build powerful decks, adapt your strategy to shifting borders, and fight for control in a world where every run redraws the map.

➤ Wishlist Now on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470370/Rainbow_Legends/
